messages.body_plain:
Please follow these instructions to fix this:

> According to the cellnetr website, CellNet should be installed typing:
> R CMD INSTALL -l ~/Documents/CellNet cellnetr.0.1.tar.gz
>
> But sometimes, we got the following error message:

>
> * installing *source* package ‘cellnetr’ ...

> ERROR: a 'NAMESPACE' file is required
> * removing ~/Documents/CellNet/cellnetr’
>
> To solve this, we can try this post:
> http://stackoverflow.com/questions/17196225/error-a-namespace-file-is-required
> This stackoverflow post solved the problem. These are the steps to install CellNet for more recent R versions:
>
> tar -xvf cellnetr.0.1.tar.gz
> cd cellnetr.0.1
> echo 'exportPattern( "." )' > NAMESPACE
> cd ..
> tar -zcf cellnetr.0.1.tar.gz cellnetr.0.1
> Then
> R CMD INSTALL -l ~/Documents/CellNet cellnetr.0.1.tar.gz
>
